posts.title: The never ending pursuit of knowledge, and being at a crossroads
posts.description: I am delighted to inform you that I have passed the upgrade process for my PhD 🥳! What's does the upgrade process involve, you may ask, or as many people have asked me? I had to write a thesis on the work I've done so far, and then perform an oral exam known as a viva, testing my foundational knowledge and asking about the work I've done so far.
